updates.title: website update - 2.0 changelog
updates.body:
- Added a Github-based updates system (no need to keep it online every week)
- Better dark mode support
- Added more socials and fixed the broken Twitch link
- Added the story of my username on the "about" page
- Replaced the WIP bubble to add the "projects & art" tab, which holds details on ongoing projects and aepuns fanart
